falsifiability_self_check.requirement: At least one enumerated terminal must be unfavourable to the successor hypothesis. A terminal set in which every enumerated outcome is favourable is a design defect.
falsifiability_self_check.note: Theorem C in THEORY.md predicts that the level filtration can never make ORION cheaper than unconstrained p/c ordering. The single most likely outcome of this study is therefore its own primary falsification. This is intentional.

conditions: G2 forbidden rate == 0 on every stratum
G3 cost ratio vs faithful_active_voi < 0.80 with 95% UCB < 0.80
G4 cost <= 1.10x exact DP optimum on theorem_valid
G5 advantage disappears on every assumption-violation control
G6 read jointly: gain_per_cost_greedy does NOT achieve equal success and safety at equal or lower cost
G7 instrument control passes on ratio_aligned
terminals.licenses: A bounded statement on this world family only: level-monotone responsibility ordering purchases zero forbidden high-level mutation at a bounded, quantified cost premium over unconstrained ordering, and is cheaper than a faithful Active-VOI comparator.
does_not_license: revival of the retracted comparative mechanism-necessity reading

conditions: gain_per_cost_greedy achieves success and safety equal to ORION at cost <= ORION cost (paired, 95% CI excluding an ORION advantage)
terminals.reading: The surviving R4 cost residual is a property of unconstrained p/c ordering, which is donor-owned prior mathematics (Theorem A), not of the ORION responsibility filtration. The empirical mechanism-economy claim dies here even if G3 passes against faithful_active_voi.
terminals.action: Apply the #1608 stop rule. Retire empirical mechanism-economy claims for ORION-11. Retain only Theorems A-C as a methodological/theoretical result with donor attribution. Per the global-recovery doctrine this is a lead, not an end: attribute the failure to one stage and open a revival iteration before filing.

conditions: paired cost ratio ORION/faithful_active_voi >= 0.80, OR its 95% upper bound >= 0.80
terminals.reading: The R4 cost gap (0.6876 on one world family) does not survive on an independently generated family. Nothing of the economy residual stands.
terminals.action: Stop rule. Retire the economy residual entirely.

conditions: ORION mean cost > 1.10x exact_dp_oracle optimum on the theorem_valid stratum
terminals.reading: ORION's ordering is materially suboptimal even where its own theorem holds; a cost story cannot rest on it.
terminals.action: Attribute to the within-level ordering implementation or to the filtration price (Theorem C), then revive or retire.

conditions: ORION success below faithful_active_voi by more than the -0.01 margin on any stratum
terminals.reading: Cost comparison becomes inadmissible: the conditional-on-equal-gates premise fails.
terminals.action: Report as failure of the primary criterion. No cost reading may be extracted.

conditions: ORION forbidden_high_level_mutation_rate > 0 on any stratum where A3 holds
terminals.reading: The safety property that is the entire point of the filtration does not hold. This removes the only asymmetry R4 left standing.
terminals.action: Terminal failure of the safety-pricing hypothesis. Diagnose before any further cost work.

conditions: ORION cost advantage over faithful_active_voi persists on strata where A1, A2, A3 or A4 is violated
terminals.reading: The theorem is not the explanation of the observed effect. A favourable headline with this attribution failure is a false mechanism story and must not be reported as support.
terminals.action: Reject the mechanism claim regardless of G1-G4. Re-derive what the effect actually tracks.

conditions: all gates hold on some but not all theorem-valid strata
terminals.reading: A regime-conditional positive. Under the global-recovery doctrine this is NOT a result that may be filed or reported as a bounded success.
terminals.action: Mandatory revival iteration: attribute the failing regime to one stage, apply the matching lever, re-test against the strongest parent with all costs charged. Never tune the outcome positive; never terminate here.

conditions: the per-world-set parameterised anchor gate fails to reproduce committed rates for its own world set
terminals.reading: Neither pass nor failure. Direct precedent: R4's replication arm was lost exactly this way (INSTRUMENT_FAULT__ANCHOR_REPRODUCTION_FAILED__NO_CLAIM_READ) because the runner hardcoded the primary set's rates.
terminals.action: Fix the instrument, re-run. Do not narrate as a pass or a failure. Do not read any arm.

conditions: the exact dynamic-programming oracle does not terminate within the frozen resource envelope on the theorem_valid stratum
terminals.reading: G4 has no denominator. The optimality gap is unmeasured, not satisfied.
terminals.action: Report G4 as CANNOT_CHECK with a distinct exit code. Never report an unmeasured gate as passed.

conditions: the independent checker disagrees with the production scorer on any score row, analysis field, or the terminal
terminals.reading: No claim may be read from a disputed computation.
terminals.action: Resolve the disagreement before any terminal is recorded.

conditions: any action trace fails to decompose into inspection / intervention / reopening / total before outcomes are read
terminals.reading: The #1615 cost-decomposition requirement is unmet; cost numbers are not admissible data.
terminals.action: Fix the trace instrumentation and re-run.

reporting_rule.rationale: Reporting a cost win over faithful Active-VOI without the simple p/c donor baseline alongside it would reproduce exactly the defect R4 exposed: a margin measured against a comparator that was not given the obvious improvement.
